title: Fit retry attempts inside one route deadline
description: Change load, request semantics, failure type, and timeout policy. The lab exposes the maximum attempt pressure permitted by the selected bounds; it does not predict benchmark throughput.

operations.label: Idempotent catalog read
operations.detail: A repeated GET returns the same logical result and does not create another business action.

operations.label: Payment creation
operations.detail: A repeated request can create a second charge unless the application enforces an idempotency key.

failures.label: Connection reset
failures.detail: The route policy explicitly includes reset in retryOn.

failures.label: Upstream HTTP 503
failures.detail: The route policy explicitly includes 503 in retryOn.

failures.label: Application HTTP 400
failures.detail: A rejected client request is not a transient failure and is excluded from retryOn.
